lines.zh: 我的壳是几层叠起来的。
lines.en: My shell is layered several times over.

lines.zh: 四格高的身躯压过灌木。
lines.en: A four-block frame crushes through the brush.
Each step grinds at the joints.

lines.zh: 那些棱晶在我背上发亮。
lines.en: The prisms on my back catch the light.
I walk the route I took before.
This armor runs thicker than my kin's.

lines.zh: 我的脚步落下，林间安静了。
lines.en: I set a foot down and the forest quiets.
Water sounds from inside the shell.
I skirt the edge of the marsh.
Mud clings to my legs, heavier by the step.

lines.zh: 我的影子把整条小路铺满。
lines.en: My shadow covers the whole path.
I keep my head low and shift slowly.
The trees ahead I simply push through.

lines.zh: 我体内的东西一直醒着。
lines.en: What lives inside me never sleeps.
Long walking, and my bearing never changes.
Every step rings like a bell.
I stand, and the layers of shell creak.
The prism light blinks on and off.
My hands hang below my knees.
This is the first time I have stopped.
The water inside moves slowly.
Something in the woods is watching me.
I turn half my body.
Mud and moss still hang on the shell.
I try closing my fist.
The knuckles make a small sound.

lines.zh: 我站着，壳层之间吱吱响。
lines.en: I stand still while my shell layers creak.

lines.zh: 四格高的甲壳，走起来很沉。
lines.en: Four blocks of chitin walk heavily.

lines.zh: 有一阵风从沼泽那边来。
lines.en: A wind comes from the marsh.
I stay still and let it pass.
You are at my feet, very small indeed.
I look down for a long while.
You carry the smell of somewhere else.

lines.zh: 我在分辨你是不是敌人。
lines.en: I am deciding if you are an enemy.
Your hands have not moved at all.
Then neither do I.
You took one step back.
I shift one step forward.
And so we stand.
What is it you want?
A seam has split in my shell.
That one got through.
Half a step back, and the ground gives.
The water in the shell sloshes.
The shell rings, an ugly sound.
I did not cry out.
I have fixed that blow in mind.
Your arm is stronger than mine.
I plant my feet again.
This body still holds.
What grows on land never enters me.
That much I would not even taste.
Keep it; I am not hungry.
The smell of the sea is better than that.

lines.zh: 我体内有别的东西在供养。
lines.en: Something else inside sustains me.
You have held it up too long.
Put it away; it wearies me.
Even this smell is unknown to me.
Do not bring it near my shell.
I have no need of it.
Your shoulder hits my leg.
I barely registered it.

lines.zh: 你撞在我的棱晶上，别喊疼。
lines.en: You hit my crystal shards — don't cry about it.
My shell fills the whole way.
Did a prism catch you?
I cannot pull those points in.
I shift one step sideways.
This path is too narrow.
You are under my shadow.
Walk a little slower.
Such things I do not understand.
Nothing but growth remains inside me.
My kind never do this.
You are asking wrongly.
I lack that organ.
Move off to a distance.
This subject is too heavy.
Speak of another matter.
I make no sound.
There is none of that between us.
Small things I can pick up.
I pinch it between two knuckles.
It feels like a grain in my grip.
I dare not squeeze.
Whose thing is this?

lines.zh: 我这两根指节，夹得起它。
lines.en: These two knuckles of mine can pinch it up.
Do you want it back?
There are shards on the ground too.
I gather them one by one.
Then no one will tread on them.
Something struck my back.
I must turn around.
I turn my whole body about.
The layers of shell draw tight.
I remember the blow you struck.

lines.zh: 你打在我背甲上，我转过身。
lines.en: You struck my back plate, so I turn around.
My arm is already up.
There is a tree behind you.

lines.zh: 壳层正一层层收紧起来。
lines.en: My shell layers are tightening one after another.
Let us begin this way.

lines.zh: 你绕到侧面，那边也是壳。
lines.en: You circle to my flank — that side is shell too.
The plates close slowly.
One blow and I turn to you.
I do not keep these long.
My movements are always slower.
But I can take the blows.
You circle to my flank.
That side is shell as well.
Your foot is pressing a root.
I saw all of that.
My whole arm comes down.
The prisms push out from the shell.
This one is not fast.
But the weight is frightening.
My fist lands beside you.
A crack opens in the ground.
I shove you clean away.
You blocked, and your hands shook.
I did not stop.
The second blow is already here.

lines.zh: 我从来处一步步走进来。
lines.en: I walk in step by step from where I came.
The mud on my shell is still wet.
This place is brighter than I expected.
I am looking for the way to water.
Someone summoned me from the soil.
The prisms flash once.
I settle and look around.
The trees here will not stop me.
I hear the sound of the sea.
It is still far away.

lines.zh: 火焰让壳层发脆，我拍打它。
lines.en: Fire makes the layers brittle; I beat at them.

lines.zh: 我摔下去，整片地都响了。
lines.en: I fall, and the whole ground rings.
Water wraps me and I slow instead.

lines.zh: 爆风把我推得歪了一步。
lines.en: The blast tips me one step aside.

lines.zh: 一支尖物钻进壳缝，拔不出来。
lines.en: Something sharp is stuck in my seam.

lines.zh: 法术在壳里面搅了一下。
lines.en: The spell stirs something inside the shell.

lines.zh: 我很久没有吸过水汽了。
lines.en: I have not drawn moisture in a long time.
Lightning passes through the prisms into me.
The soil under me is all pulled away.
